scripts.text: Do you have business with me?
I came to the ruined village,
looking for some materials. Touched some strange light, and now I'm here.
scripts.translation: 碰到一道奇怪的光之后，就到了这里。

scripts.text: I've decided to stick around for a little while. Figured I'd be safe so long as I stay close to this soldier.
scripts.translation: 我决定暂时留在这里。只要待在这位士兵身边，应该就安全。

scripts.text: I have a proposition for you. I want some materials that can only be found in this place.
scripts.translation: 我有个提议。我需要一些只有这里才有的材料。

scripts.text: Get them for me, and I'll improve your equipment in exchange. Just so you know, I can only improve certain types.
scripts.translation: 帮我弄来这些材料，我就帮你强化装备。不过我只能强化特定类型的装备。

scripts.text: If you're interested, we can discuss the details of our bargain.
scripts.translation: 感兴趣的话，我们可以谈谈交易的细节。

scripts.text: Make sure ^0000FFyour equipment is refined to at least +9^000000 before bringing it to me.
scripts.translation: 带装备来之前，务必确保^0000FF精炼等级至少为+9^000000。

scripts.text: That's the minimum requirement for my upgrade service to have any visible effects on your equipment.
scripts.translation: 这是我的强化服务能对装备产生明显效果的最低要求。

scripts.text: Make sure you're ^0000FFequipped with the item that you want to improve.^000000
scripts.translation: 务必^0000FF装备上你想强化的物品。^000000

scripts.text: Otherwise, I can't evaluate its condition.
scripts.translation: 否则我无法评估它的状态。

scripts.text: As you may have guessed, your equipment will transform into something new after this.
scripts.translation: 你可能已经猜到了，强化后你的装备会变成全新的物品。

scripts.text: In other words, ^0000FFIt'll lose its current refining levels, cards and enchantments.^000000
scripts.translation: 也就是说，^0000FF当前的精炼等级、卡片和附魔都会消失。^000000

scripts.text: And I need ^0000FFIllusion Stones and some other materials^000000 to upgrade your equipment.
scripts.translation: 强化装备还需要^0000FF幻象石和其他材料^000000。

scripts.text: Pick an item you want and I'll tell you what I need.
scripts.translation: 选一件你想强化的装备，我会告诉你所需材料。

scripts.text: Adventurer, do you have ^0000cdIllusion Stones^000000? If you have a ^0000cdweapon, a piece armor^000000, or ^0000cdan accessory at Refining Level 9 or higher^000000,
scripts.translation: 冒险者，你有^0000cd幻象石^000000吗？如果你有^0000cd武器或防具^000000，或^0000cd精炼等级9以上的饰品^000000，

scripts.text: then I can exchange it for something better at the cost of some Illusion Stones and other materials.
scripts.translation: 我可以收取一些幻象石和其他材料，把它换成更好的装备。

scripts.text: Can I strengthen the exchanged item?
scripts.translation: 兑换后的物品可以强化吗？

scripts.text: Use it well and come see me later if you find more Illusion Stones! *Chuckle*
scripts.translation: 好好使用它吧。找到更多幻象石的话，再来找我！*轻笑*

scripts.text: What are ^0000cdIllusion Stones^000000, you ask? Well... I don't think anyone knows exactly what they are.
scripts.translation: 你问^0000cd幻象石^000000是什么？嗯...我想没人真正知道。

scripts.text: I only know they're rare and can only be found in some special places, and I'm here to collect them for my clients.
scripts.translation: 我只知道它们很稀有，只能在某些特殊地点找到。我来这里是替客户收集它们。

scripts.text: My clients want to figure out what these stones are. They're paying me a lot of money,
scripts.translation: 我的客户想弄清楚这些石头是什么。他们付给我很多钱，

scripts.text: so I could offer adventurers like you ^0000cdexpensive equipment in exchange for the stones^000000, and still fetch a profit.
scripts.translation: 所以我可以用^0000cd昂贵的装备向你这样的冒险者交换石头^000000，自己还能赚一笔。

scripts.text: Bring ^0000cda piece of refined equipment, Illusion Stones^000000, and various materials that are only found in this place. I'll ^0000cdupgrade the equipment, weapon, armor, or accessory?^000000for you.
scripts.translation: 带来^0000cd精炼过的装备、幻象石^000000和这里特有的各种材料。我就能替你^0000cd强化装备、武器、防具或饰品^000000。

scripts.text: This benefits both of us. Let me know if you're interested in my proposition.
scripts.translation: 这对我们双方都有好处。感兴趣的话告诉我。

scripts.text: So, you want to reinforce the equipment you get. You're thorough. I like that!
scripts.translation: 所以你想强化换来的装备。你真仔细，我喜欢！

scripts.text: A while ago, an adventurer who passed through this place told me that a chemist in Prontera refines the Illusion equipment in exchange for Illusion Stones.
scripts.translation: 不久前有位冒险者路过这里，告诉我普隆德拉有位化学家可以用幻象石精炼幻象装备。

scripts.text: It seems Illusion Stones are a popular topic everywhere. Everyone wants to know about what they are.
scripts.translation: 看来幻象石到处都是热门话题。大家都想知道它们究竟是什么。

scripts.text: If you want to refine your equipment, then go to the <NAVI>Illusion Enchanter<INFO>prontera,90,115,000,0,</INFO></NAVI> near the Town Office.
scripts.translation: 想精炼装备的话，就去城政厅附近找<NAVI>幻象附魔师<INFO>prontera,90,115,000,0,</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text: Did you find anything you liked? If you need anything, please let me know at any time.
scripts.translation: 找到喜欢的装备了吗？需要什么的话随时告诉我。

scripts.text: Ah, Illusion Stones are truly mysterious...
I'm here to find some Illusion Stones that I need for my research.
scripts.translation: 我来这里是为了寻找研究所需的幻象石。

scripts.text: This cave is very mysterious, but I'm not strong enough to explore it by myself.
scripts.translation: 这座洞穴非常神秘，但我没有足够的实力独自探索。

scripts.text: If you go in there, could you procure some things for me?
scripts.translation: 如果你要进去，能帮我找些东西吗？

scripts.text: In exchange, I'll improve your equipment.
scripts.translation: 作为交换，我会帮你强化装备。

scripts.text: Make sure ^4d4dffyour equipment is refined to at least +9^000000 before bringing it to me.
scripts.translation: 带装备来之前，务必确保^4d4dff精炼等级至少为+9^000000。

scripts.text: Make sure you're ^4d4dffequipped with the item that you want to improve^000000.
scripts.translation: 务必^4d4dff装备上你想强化的物品^000000。

scripts.text: As you may have guessed, your equipment will transform into something new after this.
scripts.translation: 你可能已经猜到了，强化后你的装备会变成全新的物品。

scripts.text: In other words, ^4d4dffit'll lose its current Refining and Upgrade levels.^000000
scripts.translation: 也就是说，^4d4dff当前的精炼等级和升级等级都会消失。^000000

scripts.text: And I need ^4d4dffIllusion Stones and some other materials^000000 to upgrade your equipment.
scripts.translation: 强化装备还需要^4d4dff幻象石和其他材料^000000。

scripts.text: Pick an item you want. I'll tell you what I need.
scripts.translation: 选一件你想强化的装备，我会告诉你所需材料。

scripts.text: I'm overweight. I'd better lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 负重过高了，得先减轻一下背包的重量。

scripts.text: Oh, do you have Illusion equipment?
No. I don't even know what Illusion equipment is.
Oops, I'm sorry. I should've introduced myself first.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，抱歉，我应该先自我介绍。

scripts.text: I'm a chemist specializing in the study of Illusion Stones, which have been circulating among adventurers.
scripts.translation: 我是专门研究幻象石的化学家。最近冒险者之间流传着这种石头。

scripts.text: You don't know, don't you? They're the hottest trend these days.
scripts.translation: 你还不知道吧？这可是最近最热门的话题。

scripts.text: You must have heard about the strange places that have sprung up here and there lately. Illusion Stones are only found in those places,
scripts.translation: 你一定听说过最近各地陆续出现的奇异地点。幻象石只在那些地方出现，

scripts.text: and their atomic structure is unlike any mineral I've seen. *Blah Blah* ...Their chemical chains... *Blah Blah*
scripts.translation: 它们的原子结构也和我见过的任何矿物都不同。*喋喋不休*...它们的化学链...*喋喋不休*

scripts.text: Anyway, I can enchant equipment that is exchanged for or purchased with Illusion Stones. I call them the Illusion equipment.
scripts.translation: 总之，我可以为用幻象石兑换或购买的装备附魔。我把它们称为幻象装备。

scripts.text: (He has no sense when it comes to names.)
This equipment at least responds positively to Illusion Stones, or it has the potential to be enchanted successfully.
scripts.translation: 至少这些装备能与幻象石产生良好反应，具备成功附魔的潜力。

scripts.text: Explore the worlds of illusions, collect Illusion Stones, and exchange them for equipment. I can enchant the equipment for you.
scripts.translation: 去探索幻象世界、收集幻象石并兑换装备吧。我可以为这些装备附魔。

scripts.text: This benefits both of us. I need Illusion Stones for my studies, and you need powerful equipment for your adventures.
scripts.translation: 这对我们双方都有好处。我需要幻象石做研究，而你需要强力装备来冒险。

scripts.text: That said, my service is not for free. It requires a few Illusion Stones and Zeny.
scripts.translation: 不过我的服务不是免费的，需要一些幻象石和Zeny。

scripts.text: If you're interested, how'd you like to get a membership for my service? You can get discounts that way!
scripts.translation: 感兴趣的话，要不要加入我的会员？这样可以享受折扣！

scripts.text: Okay, but let me know if you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 好吧，改变主意的话再告诉我。

scripts.text: Alright, then I'll add you to my member list. I hope you'll have some Illusion equipment next time I see you.
scripts.translation: 好，那我把你加入会员名单。希望下次见面时你已经有幻象装备了。
我可以为幻象装备附魔。

scripts.text: First, let me tell you that I can only enchant certain types of Illusion equipment.
scripts.translation: 首先，我只能为特定类型的幻象装备附魔。

scripts.text: Up to 2 sockets can be enchanted, and enchanting each socket requires 5 Illusion Stones. You can reset enchanted Illusion equipment at any time.
scripts.translation: 最多可以附魔2个栏位，每个栏位需要5个幻象石。你随时可以重置附魔后的幻象装备。

scripts.text: Enchanting never fails, but resetting sometimes failes. Even modern science can't change that.
scripts.translation: 附魔不会失败，但重置有时会失败。即使现代科学也改变不了这一点。

scripts.text: Resetting requires a different amount of Zeny depending on the success chance you choose. Select the menu if you'd like to see the available payment options.
scripts.translation: 根据你选择的成功率，重置所需的Zeny也不同。选择菜单即可查看可选费用。

scripts.text: You must be equipped with an item in the selected location to have it enchanted.
scripts.translation: 必须在所选栏位装备物品才能进行附魔。

scripts.text: This equipment is not from a world of fantastic illusions. I'm offended that you even showed it to me.
scripts.translation: 这件装备并非来自奇幻幻象世界。你竟然拿给我看，真让我不高兴。

scripts.text: ^ff0000Random options are checked for that equipment. The equipment cannot be enchanted.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000检测到该装备带有随机属性，无法进行附魔。^000000

scripts.text: This is the best of all Illusion equipment. There's no technology available in this day and age that can enchant it. Even the most skilled enchanter can't do that.
scripts.translation: 这是最顶级的幻象装备。以如今的技术还无法为它附魔，就连最优秀的附魔师也做不到。

scripts.text: Well, not unless he's willing to risk his mental and physical health.
scripts.translation: 除非他愿意拿身心健康冒险。

scripts.text: But who knows? Maybe someday you'll meet someone who is talented enough to handle this precious equipment.
scripts.translation: 不过谁知道呢？也许有一天你会遇到一位足以驾驭这件珍贵装备的高手。

scripts.text: This equipment is already enchanted to the maximum limit.
scripts.translation: 这件装备已经附魔到上限了。

scripts.text: What kind of effect would you like to add?

I'll try to enchant the {0} ability for your item. ^ff0000Its existing Refining level and cards will not be damaged. It will not be destroyed, even if this attempt fails.^000000 Do you want to continue?
scripts.translation: 我将尝试为你的装备附加{0}能力。^ff0000原有精炼等级和卡片不会受影响，即使失败也不会损坏。^000000要继续吗？

scripts.text: No problem. Come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 没问题。改变主意的话再来找我。

scripts.text: This item requires {0} {1}, and you don't have all that I need from you.
scripts.translation: 这项操作需要{0}个{1}，但你带来的数量不够。

scripts.text: Only fully enchanted items can be reset. Please enchant it twice, and if you still want to reset it, then bring it to me.
scripts.translation: 只有完成全部附魔的装备才能重置。请先附魔两次，如果还想重置，再来找我。

scripts.text: Your resetting chance varies, depending on the amount of Zeny you pay. What would you like to do?
scripts.translation: 重置成功率会根据你支付的Zeny金额而变化。你想怎么做？

scripts.text: No problem. Come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 没问题。改变主意的话再来找我。

scripts.text: Ah, that was unfortunate. Well, you can't always be lucky.
scripts.translation: 啊，真不走运。好运不会永远眷顾你。

scripts.text: I'm the one who researches {0} to enhance armors and weapons.
scripts.translation: 我负责研究{0}，用于强化武器和防具。

scripts.text: If you have the materials I need for my research, wouldn't you hand them over?
scripts.translation: 如果你有我研究所需的材料，可以交给我吗？

scripts.text: If you give me some equipment and some materials, I'll exchange them for my reinforced equipment.
scripts.translation: 给我一些装备和材料，我就会用强化装备与你交换。

scripts.text: I'm working on how to use an {0} to strengthen equipment.
scripts.translation: 我正在研究如何利用{0}强化装备。

scripts.text: I went to go to the place where {0} was found, and I barely got back..
scripts.translation: 我去了发现{0}的地方，差点没能回来..

scripts.text: I think I met a girl...
scripts.translation: 我想我遇到了一个女孩...

scripts.text: Anyway, after that, I couldn't find a way to go back.
scripts.translation: 总之，从那以后我就找不到回去的路了。

scripts.text: Here, we're getting research materials from adventurers with {0}, and I'm offering enhanced equipment instead.
scripts.translation: 在这里，我们向冒险者收集{0}作为研究材料，并以强化装备作为回报。

scripts.text: What are the equipment I can exchange? Wait a minute. I'll let you know.
scripts.translation: 能兑换哪些装备？稍等，我告诉你。

scripts.text: As a material, you can bring ^0000CDexisting equipment that have been refined to +9 or higher.^000000
scripts.translation: 作为材料，你可以带来^0000CD精炼等级+9或以上的现有装备。^000000

scripts.text: And I need some ^0000CD{0} and other materials.^000000
scripts.translation: 我还需要一些^0000CD{0}和其他材料。^000000

scripts.text: Of course, we're giving you new equipment, so don't forget that all the existing ^0000CDsmelting and enchantments^000000 will disappear.
scripts.translation: 当然，我们会给你新装备，所以别忘了，原有的^0000CD精炼和附魔^000000都会消失。

scripts.text: So, what kind of weapon do you want?
I've also rolled up my sleeves for the adventurers who work hard for the village. Can I make your equipment stronger? Is there anything on the list you want?
scripts.translation: 我也会为努力守护村庄的冒险者出一份力。要我强化你的装备吗？清单上有你想要的吗？

scripts.text: Please come later. Just bring the ingredients and I'll make it for you.
scripts.translation: 之后再来吧。带齐材料我就能帮你制作。

scripts.text: Who made it? It might be useful for you to take it with you.
scripts.translation: 是谁做的？带在身上或许会派上用场。

scripts.text: Conversation cannot proceed because you have too many items.
scripts.translation: 携带物品过多，无法继续对话。

scripts.text: Please clean up your inventory and try again.
Hello. If you have rare materials from this place, I can enhance your equipment.
scripts.translation: 你好。如果你有这里的稀有材料，我可以强化你的装备。

scripts.text: Would you like to see upgradeable equipment?
scripts.translation: 要看看可以升级的装备吗？

scripts.text: There are many types, so take your time. If you want something, I can enhance it right away.
scripts.translation: 种类很多，慢慢挑。看中哪件的话，我可以马上帮你强化。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text: I feel like I'm going crazy.
It's because of my mood. I'm human and it's not like you're mistaken.
scripts.translation: 只是心情不好。我是人类，你没认错。

scripts.text: I'll help you if you get a lot here.
scripts.translation: 你要是在这里弄到很多材料，我就帮你。

scripts.text: Do you want to enhance your equipment?
I'm selling two random optional weapon grant scrolls that I made myself. You can choose the payment method you like.
scripts.translation: 我在出售两种自制的随机武器附魔券。你可以选择喜欢的付款方式。

scripts.text: If you give me an {0}, I'll do something nice for you!
scripts.translation: 只要你给我一个{0}，我就会给你点好东西！

scripts.text: The other teddy bears were in line, so I was in line too!
scripts.translation: 其他泰迪熊都排队了，所以我也排了！

scripts.text: I didn't know it was here!
I don't know but I want some!
Makes you good with what you have!
scripts.translation: 有这些就能让你变得很强！

scripts.text: If you want to do well, bring equipment refined to ^ff0000+9 or higher. It'll all disappear... haha?^000000
scripts.translation: 想提升实力的话，带上精炼至^ff0000+9或以上的装备。装备上的东西都会消失...哈哈？^000000

scripts.text: ^ff0000{0}^000000!!! {1} is the most important thing, but... other materials are also needed.
For every good thing you need another good thing.
scripts.translation: 好东西总要配上其他好东西。
